# TUI (TaeinUI)

> A React + TypeScript UI component library where each component carries its own motion.
> GSAP is the motion runtime (21 components today); visibility, legibility and readability
> are never traded for it. Zero-runtime CSS via Vanilla Extract, tree-shakable, WCAG 2.2 AA.
> Runtime dependencies: @vanilla-extract/css, @vanilla-extract/recipes, clsx, gsap.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @taein-ui/core
# or
pnpm add @taein-ui/core
```

## Setup

```tsx
// main.tsx
import '@taein-ui/core/styles.css';

function App() {
  return <YourApp />;
}
```

## API Patterns

UI components follow consistent patterns:
- `variant`: Visual style (e.g., 'primary' | 'dark' | 'light')
- `size`: Component size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg')
- `disabled`: Disabled state (boolean)
- `className`: Additional CSS class (string)
- `ref`: All components support forwardRef
- Form components require `label` prop for accessibility

Motion components (HangulAssemble, BrushText, CopyButton, BurstToggle, HoldButton, SloshGauge, RocketButton, LuminousFlow) take only `className` and `ref` (and `disabled` where it applies). They have no `size` or `variant`. GooeySearch is the exception: it is a controlled input with its own props. CopyButton also takes `value` and its label props. BurstToggle also takes `selected`, `selectedIcon` and a required `aria-label`. HoldButton also takes a required `onConfirm` and `confirmLabel`. SloshGauge also takes a required `value` and `label`, plus `min`, `max`, `valueText` and `paused`. FanMenu also takes a required `label` and `items` (2 to 8 `{ icon, label, onSelect }`). RocketButton also takes `sentLabel`, `container` and `smoke`. ManuscriptFlip also takes `front`, `back` and `flipped` (all required). MorphingIcon also takes a required `pair` and `active`. LuminousFlow is a background that fills its parent box: it takes `scrollScene` and `paused` and no other props. CodeSlots is a form component, not a plain motion one: it takes a required `label` like the other form components, plus `length`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `onComplete`, `helperText`, `error`, `errorMessage`, `success` and `successMessage`.

## Components (38 families, 46 exports)

세는 규칙: 아래 목록은 컴포넌트 **계열** 38개다. 최상위 export는 46개인데,
차이는 개별로도 import할 수 있는 합성 하위 컴포넌트(`AvatarGroup`,
`ListItem`, `SideSheetHeader` 등)다. 두 숫자 모두 소스에서 검증된다.

### Form & Input
- **TextField** - Text input with label, validation, helper text. Add `multiline` for a multiline textarea. Props: label, type, size, error, errorMessage, success, successMessage, helperText, fullWidth, multiline, rows, autoResize (rows and autoResize only with multiline; type only without)
- **Checkbox**: Checkbox with label, indeterminate state. Props: label, size, error, errorMessage, helperText, indeterminate
- **Switch**: Toggle switch. Props: label, size, error, errorMessage, helperText
- **Slider**: Range slider with marks and value display. Props: label, variant, min, max, step, showValue, showThumbValue, marks, trackColor
- **NumericSpinner**: Number input with increment/decrement buttons. Props: label, size, min, max, step. Type a number directly (committed on blur/Enter, clamped to min/max) or use ArrowUp/ArrowDown

### Button & Action
- **Button**: Primary action button. Props: variant('primary'|'dark'|'danger'|'light'), buttonStyle('strong'|'weak'), size, loading, leftIcon, rightIcon, fullWidth, customColor
- **IconButton**: Turns an icon from any icon library (lucide-react, react-icons, etc.) into a button. Pass the icon as children; the button size sets the icon size. Props: variant, buttonStyle('ghost'|'weak'|'strong', default ghost), size, hoverEffect('none'|'jelly', default jelly, on by default and turned off with "none"; the icon spreads and wobbles back when the mouse enters), loading, aria-label (required)
- **SegmentedButtons**: Button group for single selection. Props: options[{value,label,icon?}], value, onChange, size, aria-label or aria-labelledby (one is required). Roving tab order: Tab enters once, arrow keys, Home and End move

### Display & Data
- **Badge**: Status/count indicator. Props: variant('primary'|'secondary'|'success'|'error'|'warning'), size, max, dot. No default role; text is the accessible name, `dot` needs aria-label (role="img") or is hidden
- **Chip** - Tag/filter chip. Props: label, variant('filled'|'outlined'), color, icon, avatar, onDelete, onClick (makes it a pressable button), selected (with onClick: toggle chip, aria-pressed; without onClick: selected look only)
- **Avatar** - User avatar with image, fallback, status. Props: src, alt, size, variant('circular'|'rounded'|'square'), status, bouncy(opt-in hover/focus float + press grow, needs onClick or href)

### Feedback & Status
- **Loader** - Loading indicator (orbit/spinner/dots/bar/wave, default orbit), preset or any CSS color. Props: type, size, color, label, fullScreen, overlay, status(all types: 'loading'|'done'|'error', bar fills green on success or shakes red on failure without icons; spinner closes its ring then pops a check or X from scale 0.6 with snap transform and settle opacity; other types form a check or X; reduced motion shows final states immediately)
- **Skeleton** - Content placeholder. Props: variant('text'|'rect'|'circle'|'rounded'), animation('wave'|'pulse'|false), width, height. Decorative (`aria-hidden`), no live region: put `aria-busy` and an `aria-label` on the wrapping element
- **Snackbar**: Toast notification. Props: open, message, severity('success'|'error'|'warning'|'info'), position, autoHideDuration, stack(default true), action. Snackbars open at the same position stack automatically (newest at the screen edge, max 3; the 4th evicts the oldest via its onClose). stack={false} keeps one Snackbar alone at its position
- **Tooltip**: Hover tooltip. Props: children, content, position, delay, arrow

### Overlay
- **Modal**: Dialog modal. Props: open, onClose, size('sm'-'xl'|'full'), closeOnBackdropClick, closeOnEscape, container, triggerRef. 누른 요소를 자동으로 읽어 숨기고 그 모양·색에서 창으로 자란 뒤 내용을 표시한다. 닫으면 현재 요소 자리로 줄어든 뒤 요소와 포커스를 복원한다. 요소 없음·화면 밖은 가운데 등장, 축소 모션은 숨김 없이 즉시 표시. Compound: Modal.Header, Modal.Title, Modal.Content, Modal.Footer. 간단하면 prop(`title`·`footer`), 직접 꾸미려면 조합(`Modal.Header` 등)
- **BottomSheet**: Mobile bottom drawer. Props: open, onClose, height('auto'|'sm'-'lg'|'full'), enableDrag, showHandle, container. Compound: BottomSheet.Header, BottomSheet.Title, BottomSheet.Content
- **SideSheet**: Side panel drawer. Props: open, onClose, width('sm'-'lg'|'full'), position('left'|'right'), container. Compound: SideSheet.Header, SideSheet.Title, SideSheet.Content
- **Popover**: Popover panel. Props: children(trigger), content, position, closeOnOutsideClick, arrow

### Layout
- **Card**: Content container. Props: variant('outlined'|'elevated'|'filled'), onClick, hoverLift(opt-in lift on hover). Compound: Card.Image, Card.Header, Card.Title, Card.Body, Card.Footer. 간단하면 prop(`title`·`footer`·`image`), 직접 꾸미려면 조합(`Card.Body` 등)
- **List**: Ordered list with spacing. Props: spacing, divider. Child: ListItem(label, value, layout)
- **BoardRow**: Expandable row/accordion. Props: title, variant, expanded, onChange, disabled
- **Divider**: Content separator. Props: orientation, variant('solid'|'dashed'|'dotted'), spacing, children(text)
- **Border**: Border wrapper. Props: sides, variant, width, color, rounded('md' default for sides='all', 'none' for partial sides), padding, glow(opt-in single fading-tail light along the rounded perimeter, 3000ms per lap with two slow-fast-slow segments; reduced motion stays at the start)
- **HeaderBar** - Floating rounded app header bar (centered, max 960px, 60px tall). Props: logo, title, titleAs('h1' default | 'h2'-'h6' | 'span'), items(`{ label, href?, onClick?, icon?, active?, links? }`), navStyle('pill' default | 'text' | 'dropdown' | 'cards' | 'icon'), actions, sticky. The root is a plain `<header>`, so it is the banner landmark only at the top level of the document. Under 768px the items fold into a hamburger + vertical list

### Motion
- **HangulAssemble**: Sentence whose Hangul syllables assemble from pieces of the rendered syllable, cut out by jamo region (ㅎ, ㅏ, ㄴ of 한), that fly in and interlock when it scrolls into view, once. Props: text(required), as('p' default | 'h1'-'h6' | 'span' | 'div'), className, ref. The first render is the finished sentence; the scattered start is applied just before playback (after the root font has loaded, waiting at most 3 seconds), so SSR and no-JS show plain text. Reduced motion or no IntersectionObserver: always the finished sentence. Screen readers read one visually hidden copy of `text`; the animated layer is `aria-hidden`. Non-Hangul characters only fade in. Changing `text` does not replay
- **BrushText**: Sentence written as if by a brush when it scrolls into view, once. At playback each syllable is drawn to a canvas in the same font and color, the ink is measured, and each connected blob of ink is found as a stroke. The jamo are written one after another (initial, vowel, final), strokes within a jamo from top to bottom (left to right at the same height), and the brush front moves along the inside of each stroke at a steady speed, so a bent stroke is drawn along its bend. The front is hard-edged; there is no blur or bleed (the brush texture comes from the font). Props: text(required), as('p' default | 'h1'-'h6' | 'span' | 'div'), className, ref. It ships no font: it uses the parent's `font-family` (a brush font such as Nanum Brush Script, OFL, looks best; any font works the same). A stroke takes 200ms per em of its length (at least 60ms); the brush lifts for 60ms between strokes of one jamo, 100ms between jamo and 150ms between syllables. There is no cap on the total length. Measuring and redrawing pixels costs time per syllable, so it is for short lines, not long paragraphs. The first render is the finished sentence; the hidden start is applied just before playback (after the root font has loaded, waiting at most 3 seconds), so SSR and no-JS show plain text. Reduced motion, no IntersectionObserver or no canvas: always the finished sentence. Screen readers read one visually hidden copy of `text`; the animated layer is `aria-hidden`. A blob where a brush font joins neighbouring jamo is split by the share of its pixels in each jamo region and written jamo by jamo. The font has no stroke information, so a long stroke lying across a region border can be split in part. Non-Hangul characters are one blob each, written left to right. Changing `text` does not replay
- **GooeySearch**: Round search button that splits like a water drop to the right while the input stretches out between the two blobs; closing merges them back. Controlled: `open`, `onOpenChange(next, event?)`. The DOM event that caused the change (trigger click, Esc keydown, outside pointerdown) arrives as the second argument. Esc also returns focus to the trigger. Props: open(required), onOpenChange(required), triggerRef, openLabel('검색 열기' default), closeLabel('검색 닫기' default), inputLabel('검색' default), placeholder, inputProps(native input attributes: value, onChange, onKeyDown, role='combobox', aria-*; the component holds no input value), children(result list, placed below the input), className, ref. Focus moves to the input when the reveal ends (immediately under reduced motion). Under reduced motion it opens and closes without splitting. The consumer owns the query, the results, and the combobox wiring (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`)
- **CopyButton**: Copy button for one string. Pressing it writes `value` to the clipboard, the clipboard icon folds into a check (the lines draw in) and the label slides up out of the way while the copied label rises from below; after `loop.base` (1500ms) it returns. If the clipboard is missing or rejects the write, the icon shakes (same keyframes and tokens as the TextField error shake) and the label becomes the failed label, then returns. Props: value(required), label('복사' default, also the button's accessible name, always), copiedLabel('복사됨' default), failedLabel('복사 실패' default), onCopy(ok: boolean), disabled, className, ref (forwarded to the `<button>`), plus native button attributes except `children`, `value` and `onCopy`. A consumer `onClick` runs first and `preventDefault()` there skips the copy. No `size` or `variant`: it is the `Button` `light` outline at the `md` step. A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region reads the copied or failed label once and is emptied when the button returns. Pressing again while a result is showing copies again and restarts the timer. Under reduced motion the icon and label only cross-fade, with no movement or shake
- **BurstToggle**: Controlled toggle button for like, save and favorite. Turning it on, the icon squashes flat, springs past 1.2x and settles to 1 while it swaps to the selected icon, and a ring of 8 small primary-colored dots bursts outward from the icon center and fades. Turning it off just swaps to the off icon with a small press (no dots). Props: selected(required, `aria-pressed` follows it; the consumer holds the state), selectedIcon(required, the filled icon; fill is made by swapping two icons, not by a fill style), children(the off icon), aria-label(required, fixed in every state), disabled, className, ref (forwarded to the `<button>`), plus native button attributes except `children` and `aria-pressed`. No `size` or `variant`: the icon cell is the `IconButton` `md` size and the icon svg is 1em. The burst only happens on this button's own click going from off to on; a `selected` that is already true on mount or changes from outside does not burst. Pressing again while the burst runs clears the remaining dots at once. The dot nodes are `aria-hidden` and leave the DOM when the burst ends; the button has `overflow: visible` so dots are not clipped, and they do not push the layout. Under reduced motion only the icon swaps: no squash, spring or dots
- **HoldButton**: Hold-to-confirm button for things that cannot be undone (delete, pay, reset). Holding the press fills the button from the left (the last 30% trembles 1 to 2px, growing); when it is full it springs a check in and calls `onConfirm`. Letting go early drains the fill back. There is also a path that does not depend on time: a short press, a keyboard tap or a screen reader click only arms the button (the label becomes `confirmLabel`, the fill rests at half, a `role="status"` region announces it) and the next click calls `onConfirm`. Arming has no timer; it is released when focus leaves (Safari and macOS Firefox and iOS Safari do not focus a button on a mouse click or tap, so there it is not released that way). Props: children(required, button text), onConfirm(required, `() => void`), confirmLabel('한 번 더 누르면 실행' default), disabled, className, ref (forwarded to the `<button>`), plus native button attributes except `children` and `type` (`type` is always `button`; to submit a form, call `form.requestSubmit()` in `onConfirm`). A native `onClick` does NOT mean confirmed: a click is produced every time the press ends. No `size` or `variant`, and no hold-time prop: the hold is fixed at 1.5s (`gsapDuration.slower` x 3). It wraps `Button` `light` (`md`); the fill is `primary.main` and the text turns white where the fill has passed (an `aria-hidden` copy of the text clipped to the fill). If `disabled` turns on mid-hold, the hold is dropped and nothing runs. After running, a `role="status"` region says it is done, the button is `aria-disabled` (focus stays) and returns to rest after 2s, and it cannot run again meanwhile. Under reduced motion the hold time stays the same (shortening it would run it at once); the fill grows in four steps, with no tremble or spring
- **SloshGauge**: Display meter (`role="meter"`) that shows a value as the water level in a drop-shaped bowl (pointed top, round bottom, `primary` outline). The level is by area, not height: 50% fills half the bowl's area, so the surface sits below the middle. When `value` changes the level behaves like a spring (overshoots the target by 10 to 25%, calm within about 1.5s), the surface tilts with the level's speed (an increase lifts the left side first, up to 15 to 20 degrees) under two sine waves (a front one with a `primary` depth gradient and a light rim, a back translucent one in another phase), and a few bubble rings (at most 8) rise only while it shakes hard. The bowl itself tips by about 1 degree and stretches by under 1% on a big change, then straightens. The shake is read from the current level speed and tilt, so it does not pile up when the value keeps changing. At rest a slow, low ripple (1 to 2% of the bowl height) always remains, so it keeps moving for more than 5 seconds: `paused` is the WCAG 2.2.2 control. Props: value(required, clipped to min..max), min(0 default), max(100 default), label(required, the accessible name and the visible caption), valueText(visible value text and `aria-valuetext`; percentage like "60%" when absent), paused(false default; true freezes the water as it is with no animation loop, a value change then sets the level at once without a slosh, and false continues from the frozen look), className, ref (forwarded to the root `<div>`), plus native div attributes except `children` and `role`. `aria-valuenow` is the new value at once, not after the animation. The bowl and water are `aria-hidden`. Drawing stops while the tab is hidden or the bowl is off screen. No `size` or `variant`; the width is the parent's (7.5rem by default). Under reduced motion the surface is flat with no ripple and a value change only moves the level at once
- **CodeSlots**: One-time code / PIN input (form component, `label` required). The real input is one visually transparent `<input>` laid over the slots (`inputMode="numeric"`, `autoComplete="one-time-code"`, `maxLength={length}`, `pattern="\d*"`), so paste and SMS autofill work; the slots are `aria-hidden` pictures. A digit rolls into its slot from above (`translateY(-100%)` to 0, overshoots slightly; `base`, `snap`) and a deleted digit drops out below. `error` makes the slots shake in a wave from the left (the same kind of keyframes and tokens as the TextField error shake, `slower` and `drift`, but ±4px to fit the 8px gap; a stagger of `fast` x 0.3 per slot) with `error` borders. `success` merges the slots into one pill in two beats. First (`base`, `settle`) each slot's border and white fill fade out together while one bundle behind the slots (white fill plus a `success.dark` border) fades in. Then (`slower`, `settle`) the slots close the gap to 0 and the bundle's real width shrinks with them (no scale, so its round ends never squash) while its corners round up to the pill radius. When `success` is turned off it runs back the same way (second beat first, then the first), and a change mid-way reverses from the current shape. Focus is shown by border color, not an outer ring: while the input has focus, the slot to type into next (the last slot when full) gets a `primary` border (a mouse click does the same), and `error` wins over focus. Once merged the slots are transparent, so the bundle's `success.dark` border keeps its color and thickens from 1px to 2px while the input has focus (no ring is added; it eases with `fast` and `settle`, and changes at once under reduced motion). A slot that is disabled while focused keeps its disabled color. Props: label(required), length(6 default), value + onChange(controlled) or defaultValue(uncontrolled), onComplete(called once when `length` digits are in), helperText, error, errorMessage, success, successMessage, disabled, className (on the root), ref (forwarded to the hidden `<input>`), plus native input attributes such as `name` and `autoFocus`. Only digits are accepted; other characters are dropped (a pasted "123 456" or "G-123456" is filtered to its digits; `length` digits or more replaces the whole value, a shorter piece is appended) and input past `length` is cut. The caret always stays at the end, so delete with Backspace from the end. `aria-invalid` is true on `error`; the visible message is tied by `aria-describedby`. No `size` or `variant`. Under reduced motion digits, colors and the merged shape change at once, with no roll, drop, wave or merge transition
- **FanMenu**: Radial action menu for quick actions and share menus. A `primary` hub button with a plus; pressing it springs the `items` out along an upper half circle (radius 104px, evenly from 180 degrees on the left to 0 on the right) one after another (45ms apart, `fast` x 0.3; `slower`, `snap`, transform only), the plus turns into a cross (135deg), and a dotted guide arc appears with a `primary` glowing line drawn along it (`stroke-dashoffset`, `slower` x 1.6, `settle`). Pressing the hub again folds them back in reverse order (30ms apart). With a fine pointer (`(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`) the icon nearest the angle from the hub centre to the pointer grows to 1.38x, moves 14px outward, fills `primary` and shows its name in a tag (tracked only 36 to 230px from the centre; angles below the arc snap to the nearer end). Touch has no direction tracking: the pressed icon is chosen. Choosing an item calls its `onSelect` once, flashes (375ms) and folds, and focus returns to the hub. Props: label(required, the hub's accessible name, fixed whether open or not), items(required, 2 to 8 of `{ icon: ReactNode, label: string, onSelect: () => void }`; outside that range a development warning is logged once and only the first 8 are drawn), disabled, className (on the root), ref (forwarded to the hub `<button>`), plus native button attributes except `children`, `type` and `onSelect`. Open state is internal (uncontrolled). No `size` or `variant`. The fan always opens upward and does nothing about screen edges: the consumer leaves room (about 130px above and to each side). Menu button pattern: the hub has `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the items sit in `role="menu"` as `role="menuitem"` with roving tabindex, and the menu is `inert` while closed (and while closing). Opening with Enter, Space or ArrowUp focuses the first item; opening with the mouse keeps focus on the hub. Arrow keys in all four directions move along the arc (wrapping), Home and End go to the ends, Esc folds and returns focus to the hub, Tab moving focus out of the menu folds it, and so does a mousedown outside. While the hub has focus the items are not in the tab order; ArrowUp enters them. A focused icon grows and shows its tag like a pointed one. The tag is `aria-hidden`, closes with Esc, stays when the pointer moves onto it and never disappears on its own (WCAG 1.4.13). Under reduced motion there is no stagger, guide drawing or flash: items appear and disappear in place at once
- **RocketButton**: Send/submit button that launches like a rocket. Pressing it (pointerdown) crouches the button slightly down-left (`translate(-2px, 2px) scale(0.97)`, `fast`) and rewinds on `pointerleave` or `pointercancel`. When the native click is confirmed, a decorative copy of the button (`aria-hidden`, `inert`, ids removed) is lifted onto a fixed layer at the same screen rectangle and follows one beat function of the time: the nozzles slide out from the button's lower border (0-600ms: they sit behind the body and come out below its lower border; no jet light or smoke yet), a slow build-up (600-2600ms: the jet strength rises slowly from zero, a short wick with layered halos (a glow, not a long flame) lights up under each nozzle, and smoke with light and shade piles up on a virtual ground below the button, which stays in place, with an exhaust column running from the nozzles to the ground), then a launch (2600-5100ms: thrust grows, it lifts off heavily and slowly, accelerates, curves slowly to the right, the tilt follows the direction of its velocity up to 20deg; the virtual ground stays at the same height during the flight, so the jet that reaches it keeps making smoke there, weaker the higher the button is, and a weaker trail comes from under the nozzles) until it is out of the screen (or the `container`); the mark fades in at 5100ms. The motion is a physical model (thrust), not an easing curve, taken as a deterministic function of the time, so the same time gives the same picture. The two nozzles (small dark blobs about 14x8px at 30% of the button width on each side of the center, behind the body so only the part below its lower border shows; each has a thin mouth whose color mixes from grey to the jet color with the jet strength and a small glow below it) are plain DOM inside the copy, so they tilt with the body. One CSS custom property (`--rocket-thrust`, 0 to 1, from the beat function) drives the mouth color, the glow, a faint light on the body's underside (a decorative layer, at most 30% and only in the lowest third so the text contrast is kept) and the DOM fallback light; colors come from tokens only. Pressing again during the flight is ignored. A WebGL2 fluid smoke in white, lit from the upper left (lit faces are the white token, shaded faces and thick or deep parts `gray[400]`), rolls sideways on the virtual ground under the nozzles and trails from under the nozzles during the launch; the same canvas draws the jet glow (the short wick and the halos, which tint nearby smoke with the jet color) and the exhaust column; it is a decorative canvas behind the copy and keeps dispersing after the flight ends (turn it off with `smoke={false}`, the motion and a DOM jet light under each nozzle stay; without WebGL2 or under reduced motion the flight is the same without smoke; no Blob or worker, so a strict CSP does not matter). The original button stays in place invisible so the layout does not move, and a `sentLabel` mark ('보냈어요' default) fades in on its spot (`settle`). It does not come back: the consumer changes `key` to render it again; there is no undo API. `onClick` runs on the native click (release), never on pointerdown (WCAG 2.5.2); a consumer `preventDefault()` there skips the flight. Props: children(required, button text and accessible name), sentLabel, container(HTMLElement | null: the flight layer is drawn inside it and clipped by it; it must be a `position` reference such as `relative` and must not scroll), smoke(boolean, default true), disabled, className, ref (forwarded to the `<button>`), plus native button attributes except `children`. It wraps the `Button` primary strong (`md`): no `size` or `variant`. The mark fades in after the flight ends. Focus: if the button had focus it moves to the mark (`tabIndex=-1`) and the status region stays empty, so the text is read once; if not, nothing moves and `sentLabel` is put into a visually hidden `role="status"` region that exists from the start (a region inserted together with its text may not be read). Under reduced motion there is no flight or smoke: the button cross-fades to the mark (`base`) and the focus rule is the same
- **ManuscriptFlip**: Two-faced box whose cells flip one by one in writing order (left to right, top row to bottom row) to reveal the back face; flipping back runs the reverse order. Controlled: `flipped`. The consumer decides whether hover or press flips it (the component handles no events). `front` and `back` are free ReactNodes rendered once each (never duplicated, so ids and focus are safe), stacked in the same place; the cells are revealed by a `clip-path` mask on the two faces that changes for a cell when its plain paper tile has turned halfway (`rotationY` 0 to 180, perspective). Only transform and opacity animate. The box is split from its size into whole columns and rows of about 48px (cap 48 cells, bigger boxes get bigger cells) and re-split on resize. One cell takes `base` (200ms) `settle`; the whole flip is fixed at 700ms whatever the cell count (gap = 500ms / (cells - 1)). Flipping during a flip goes back from where it is (one timeline played/reversed), and the end is always the last intent. The hidden face is `inert` and `visibility: hidden`; during a flip both faces are `inert` and the shown face comes alive when it ends. First render (SSR included) shows the end state of `flipped` with no tiles. Reduced motion: no cells or tiles, the two faces cross-fade (`base`, `settle`). Props: front(required), back(required), flipped(required), className, ref (forwarded to the root `div`), plus native div attributes except `children`. Do not give the box inner padding (the cell grid would no longer match the faces). Keep the button that flips it outside the box: if it sits inside a face, focus is lost while the flip runs and is moved to the box (`tabIndex=-1`, no outline) when it ends, so the next Tab goes into the new face.
- **MorphingIcon**: Icon that moves between two states: its lines grow and fold into another shape by moving only their endpoints (300ms `slow` with `settle`, GSAP number tween, no MorphSVG). `pair` picks one of five fixed pairs (`'menu-close'`, `'plus-check'`, `'play-pause'`, `'search-close'`, `'expand-collapse'`); `active` false shows the first icon of the pair and true the second. One SVG (`viewBox` 24, stroke 2, round caps, `currentColor`) sized `1em`, so it takes the button's font size and color and goes into `IconButton` as is. Both states of a pair have the same number of lines and endpoints; a line that must vanish shrinks to a point while its opacity goes to 0. Changing `active` mid-move continues from the current coordinates. The SVG is `aria-hidden` and not focusable: the button around it carries the state (`aria-pressed` or a changing `aria-label`). Reduced motion changes shape at once. SSR draws the shape of `active` as is.

### Background
- **LuminousFlow**: Background that fills its parent box (`position: absolute; inset: 0`, so the parent must be a positioned box). Light strands (28) flow inside a winding river path and light motes (48) drift along it, drawn on a canvas 2D with an SVG atmosphere layer. The flow speeds up with window scroll (up to 3.3x) and calms down when scrolling stops. Fixed cyan palette on black; there is no colour override API. Props: scrollScene(false default; makes the river as tall as the box and the box height maps to the whole 2162-unit scene, and only the part near the window is drawn; otherwise only the top part of the river fills the box), paused(false default; true stops the flow and keeps the current scene (no repeating draw loop; one still frame is redrawn when the box size or, with `scrollScene`, the visible part changes), false continues without a jump in flow time; the pause control for WCAG 2.2.2), className, ref (forwarded to the root `<div>`). The root is `aria-hidden="true"` with `pointer-events: none`, so content on top stays clickable. Drawing also stops when the tab is hidden or the box is off screen. The atmosphere layer is cached as a Blob URL image, so a strict CSP needs `img-src blob:`. No `size`, `variant` or `disabled`. Under reduced motion it is one still frame (flow time 0)

## Design Tokens

TUI uses a theme contract (`themeContract`) for consistent styling. 라이트 단일
테마이며 `:root`의 전역 CSS 변수로 선언된다 (`ThemeProvider`·다크 테마 없음).

- **Color**: primary, text (primary/secondary/disabled/inverse), background, surface, border, overlay, semantic (success/warning/error/info)
  semantic은 main(면, contrast와 4.5:1) / light(배경) / dark(본문 텍스트·단독 도형, 4.5:1) / contrast 4슬롯
- **Spacing**: 8pt grid, 12단계 (0.25rem = 4px ~ 5rem = 80px). 중간 번호는 비어 있음
- **Typography**: sizes 9단계 (2xs ~ 4xl), weights, line heights, variantNumeric(tabular-nums)
- **Border Radius**: none, sm, base, md, lg, xl, full
- **Shadow**: none, sm, base, md, lg, xl, 2xl, inner
- **Animation**: durations (fast/base/slow/slower), loops (fast/base/slow), easings (settle/snap/spring/exit/linear/drift)
  공유하는 의미만 토큰이다. 컴포넌트 고유 연출의 delay도 duration·loop의 배수로
  적고, 오버슈트 이징(snap/spring)은 transform 전용이며 `transition: all`은 안 쓴다
- **Z-Index**: base < dropdown < sticky < overlay < modal < popover < toast < tooltip
- **Breakpoints**: sm 360px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px (계약 밖의 빌드 타임 상수)

전체 값과 대비비는 [Full API Reference](/llms-full.txt)의 Design Tokens 절 참고.

## Motion (GSAP Runtime)

GSAP 런타임(M3에서 시작해 M7까지)이 실제로 붙은 컴포넌트와 그 능력. 계획이 아니라 코드에서
읽었다. 아래 목록에 없는 컴포넌트는 GSAP을 쓰지 않는다(CSS 트랜지션·키프레임을 쓰고, `LuminousFlow`는 canvas 그리기 루프를, `SloshGauge`는 rAF 루프로 SVG를 고쳐 쓴다).

| 컴포넌트 | 쓰는 능력 |
| --- | --- |
| Modal | 타임라인 상대 위치 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(트리거 좌표) |
| BottomSheet | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 제스처 추적(터치 드래그 1:1) |
| SideSheet | 타임라인 상대 위치 |
| Snackbar | CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(카운트다운 진행률 read-back) · 같은 위치 쌓임 오프셋(`y`, base settle) |
| Checkbox | 모양 변형(checked ↔ indeterminate) · 다중 목표 중단 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(스프링 진행값 하나로 채움·상자 구동, 체크와 해제 모두 상자가 먼저 움츠렸다 되튐) |
| Switch | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 다중 목표 중단(이동 300ms 동안 속도에 따라 늘었다 둥글어지고, 파란 채움은 트랙 모양 안에서만 차오르고, 켜지면 트랙보다 위아래 1px 큰 크기로 머물고, 꺼지면 원래 크기로 돌아옴) |
| SegmentedButtons | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 다중 목표 중단 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(인디케이터 좌표: 표시가 새 칸까지 늘어나 두 칸을 덮었다가 뒤쪽 끝이 끌려오며 살짝 지나쳤다 제자리로 돌아온다) |
| NumericSpinner | 다중 목표 중단 |
| Slider | 제스처 추적(드래그 중 값 따라붙기) · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(머리 속도: 끌면 라인이 머리 둘레에서 속도에 비례해 부풀어 물결치고, `wake`는 그 물결을 눈금 막대로 보여 준다) |
| HeaderBar | 제스처 추적(`navStyle="icon"`의 커서가 올라간 항목 확대) · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(알약 크기, 카드 층 높이) · 다중 목표 중단(768px 미만 메뉴 판과 `navStyle="dropdown"`의 하위 링크 판: `opacity` + `y 8 → 0`, 열림 `base` `settle`, 닫힘 `fast` `settle`) · 멈춘 타임라인 재생(`navStyle="pill"`: `tweenTo` 들어옴 `slow`, 나감 `base`. `navStyle="cards"`: 면 `height`가 `slow` `settle`로 자라고 카드가 `y 50 → 0`·`opacity`를 `slow` `settle`, 시차 80ms로 3/4 지점에서 시작, 열기 `play`·닫기 `reverse`) |
| Avatar | 다중 목표 중단(떠오름과 눌림이 서로를 덮어쓰며 이어짐) |
| BoardRow | 타임라인 상대 위치 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(트윈 중간 높이, 내용 높이) |
| Chip | 타임라인 상대 위치 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(폭과 gap으로 자리 닫기) |
| IconButton | 타임라인 상대 위치(젤리 호버, 기본으로 켜져 있고 `hoverEffect="none"`으로 끈다) |
| Loader | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 다중 목표 중단 |
| HangulAssemble | 타임라인 상대 위치 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(폰트 대기용 computed font) |
| BrushText | 타임라인 상대 위치 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(폰트 대기용 computed font) |
| BurstToggle | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 다중 목표 중단 |
| HoldButton | 다중 목표 중단 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(홀드 진행값) |
| CodeSlots | 단일 트윈(숫자가 굴러 들어옴, 지우면 빠짐) + 성공 합쳐짐 타임라인 하나 |
| RocketButton | 타임라인 상대 위치 · 다중 목표 중단 · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(단추·container 좌표) |
| ManuscriptFlip | 타임라인 상대 위치 · play/reverse(도중 되넘김) · CSS가 못 보는 값 읽기(타임라인 시각으로 마스크 칸 수 계산) |
| MorphingIcon | 단일 트윈(선 끝점 좌표 숫자들을 한 번에 옮김) · 다중 목표 중단(도중 전환은 지금 좌표에서 새 목표로) |

**Flip은 이 목록 어디에도 없다.** 유일한 후보였던 `Card`는 CSS 전환으로
충분하다고 판단해 채택하지 않았다.

## Next.js & Server Components

- App Router에서 훅·컨텍스트를 쓰는 모듈에는 빌드 시 `'use client'`가 주입된다.
  소비자가 래퍼를 만들 필요 없이 서버 컴포넌트에서 바로 import할 수 있다.
- `Divider`, `Border`, `List`, `Skeleton`은 지시문이 없다. 서버 컴포넌트로 렌더된다.
  `Button`, `IconButton`은 누름 상태를 `useClickRebound` 훅이 갖기 때문에
  `'use client'`가 붙는다. 서버 컴포넌트에서 import하는 것은 그대로 된다.
- `BurstToggle`, `HoldButton`, `SloshGauge`, `CodeSlots`, `FanMenu`, `RocketButton`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 상태를 갖고 클릭·포인터·키보드 이벤트나 GSAP 타임라인이 브라우저에서만 돈다(`FanMenu`는 GSAP이 아니라 CSS 전이, `SloshGauge`는 GSAP이 아니라 rAF 루프다).
  `onClick`·`onConfirm`·`onChange`·`onSelect` 같은 함수 prop과 `RocketButton`의 `container`(DOM 요소)는 클라이언트 파일에서 넘긴다. `SloshGauge`는 표시 요소라 함수 prop이 없다.
- `ManuscriptFlip`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 상자 크기를 관찰하고 GSAP 타임라인을 돌려 브라우저에서만 돈다. 첫 렌더(서버 포함)는 `flipped` 값대로 한 면만 보이는 끝 모양이고 타일이 없다. `flipped`는 소비자가 쥐므로 그 상태를 가진 클라이언트 파일에서 렌더한다.
- `MorphingIcon`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 끝점을 옮기는 GSAP 트윈을 효과에서 돌려 브라우저에서만 돈다. 첫 렌더(서버 포함)는 `active`대로 짝의 한 모양을 그대로 그린 SVG다. `active`는 소비자가 쥐므로 그 상태를 가진 클라이언트 파일에서 렌더한다.
- `LuminousFlow`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. canvas 그리기·스크롤 구독·관찰자를 브라우저에서만 돌린다. 첫 렌더(서버 포함)는 대기층 SVG와 어두운 바탕이다.
- `Badge`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 값이 바뀔 때 헌 값을 남겨 두고 교체 모션을 돌리는 상태(`useState`)를 갖는다.
- `Loader`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. GSAP 트윈으로 그려서 브라우저에서만 돈다.
- `HangulAssemble`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 화면에 들어올 때를 보는 관찰자와 GSAP 타임라인이
  브라우저에서만 돈다. 첫 렌더(서버 포함)는 완성 문장이라 하이드레이션 전에도 글자가 보인다.
- `BrushText`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 화면에 들어올 때를 보는 관찰자와 GSAP 타임라인이
  브라우저에서만 돈다. 첫 렌더(서버 포함)는 완성 문장이라 하이드레이션 전에도 글자가 보인다.
- `GooeySearch`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 바깥 pointerdown과 Esc를 문서에서 듣고 포커스를 옮기는 효과를 갖는다.
  열림 상태는 소비자가 쥐므로 그 상태를 가진 클라이언트 파일에서 렌더한다.
- `CopyButton`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 결과 상태와 되돌림 타이머를 갖고 클릭에서 클립보드를 쓴다.
- `HeaderBar`도 `'use client'`가 붙는다. 좁은 화면 메뉴의 열림 상태와 GSAP 트윈, 그리고
  `navStyle="icon"`의 항목 확대가 브라우저에서만 돈다.
- `TextField`는 `'use client'`가 붙는다. `multiline`의 `autoResize`가 높이를 읽고 쓰는 훅을 갖는다.
- 단, 서버 컴포넌트에서 `onClick` 같은 함수 prop을 넘기는 것은 TUI와 무관하게
  React가 막는다. 이벤트 핸들러를 붙이는 쪽 파일에 `'use client'`를 적어야 한다.
- `styles.css`는 루트 레이아웃에서 한 번 import한다:
  `import '@taein-ui/core/styles.css';`
- 플래시 없음: 테마가 라이트 단일이고 `:root` 정적 CSS 변수로 선언되므로
  하이드레이션 전후 색이 바뀌지 않는다. 테마 스크립트도 필요 없다.

## Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

- Semantic HTML elements (button, input, dialog)
- ARIA attributes (aria-label, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, aria-busy, aria-modal)
- Keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow keys)
- Focus indicators (2px outline, 2px offset, 4.6:1 contrast)
- Focus traps in overlays (Modal, BottomSheet, SideSheet)
- Color contrast 4.5:1 (text), 3:1 (UI elements). 값과 실측 대비비는 Design Tokens 절 참고
- Target size: WCAG 2.2 AA(2.5.8)의 최소 요구치는 **24x24 CSS px**이고
  44x44는 AAA(2.5.5) 수준의 TUI 자체 권장치다. 인터랙티브 컴포넌트는 기본으로
  44x44를 확보하되, 좁은 화면에서 줄일 때 24x24가 AA 하한선이다.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`에서 duration 토큰과 전역 `*` 규칙이 함께
  적용돼 애니메이션·트랜지션이 멈춘다 (무한 반복도 1회로 끊긴다). GSAP으로
  움직이는 컴포넌트는 인라인 스타일로 도는 트윈이라 전역 CSS 규칙이 못 잡는다.
  그래서 각자 훅 안에서 같은 선호를 직접 확인해 트윈을 끝 상태로 확정하고
  끈다(`gateMotion`/`settleMotion`)
